title: fix: README structure, mojibake, and .env.example
head: eddyflores100-lang:fix/readme-mojibake-env-config
body:
## Summary

Closes #28, #29, #31.

Three documentation/configuration issues fixed in one PR (no code logic changes, all contributor-experience improvements):

### #28 — Fix README inaccuracies

- Updated project structure tree to match actual `src/` layout:
  `app/`, `components/{common,layout,stellar,ui}`, `contexts/`, `hooks/`, `store/slices/`, `utils/`
- Documented all 6 npm scripts: `dev`, `build`, `start`, `lint`, `test`, `typecheck`
- Added testnet-only caveat at the top of README
- Added Node 18+ requirement note

### #29 — Fix mojibake/corrupted characters

- Re-encoded `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE.md` as clean UTF-8 without BOM
- Fixed garbled box-drawing characters and corrupted text sequences
- Other files (README.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, ISSUES.md) were already clean

### #31 — Add .env.example and document environment-driven config

- Created `.env.example` with 3 environment variables:
  - `NEXT_PUBLIC_HORIZON_URL` (default: `https://horizon-testnet.stellar.org`)
  - `NEXT_PUBLIC_STELLAR_NETWORK` (default: `testnet`)
  - `NEXT_PUBLIC_FRIENDBOT_URL` (default: `https://friendbot.stellar.org`)
- Updated `src/utils/stellar.ts` to read from env vars with testnet fallback
- Contributors can now point at local Horizon or Futurenet without editing source code

## Why 3 issues in 1 PR

All three affect first-time contributor experience (broken README, garbled templates, missing env config). Grouping them avoids 3 trivial PRs and gives a cohesive 'fix the onboarding experience' commit.

## Checklist

- [x] Structure section matches the actual src tree
- [x] All scripts documented (dev/build/lint/test/typecheck)
- [x] Testnet-only caveat stated
- [x] Mojibake fixed in template files
- [x] .env.example created
- [x] stellar.ts uses env vars with safe defaults
